entries.zh: 殴打；西语例指卑幼殴打尊长
entries.en: to beat, to thrash; (in the example) the younger striking the elder

entries.zh: 笞杖（以杖或竹条笞打）；西语谓如官长执杖行笞
entries.en: to flog with a cane or rods, as with the mandarin's baton; judicial flogging, bastinado

entries.zh: 削（刮削皮肉）；西语指自鞭其背（苦修赎罪）
entries.en: to scourge one's own back (self-flagellation); lit. to scrape the skin off the back
entries.notes: 汉字「削」（刮削其肤）与西语「自鞭其背」的对应依赖推断，四栏无直证同义，降为中置信。

entries.zh: 下（计笞打次数的量词，如鞭三十下）
entries.en: 'times' — numeral/classifier counting strokes of the whip (azotes), as in 'thirty lashes'
whip, lash; a stroke of the whip
cane whip for the horse; horsewhip, riding crop
horsewhip; whip of canes for the horse

entries.zh: 棍（木棍、棍棒）；棍打，参见「惩罚」「打伤」
entries.en: wooden rod, cudgel, staff; beating with a stick (cf. castigo 'punishment', herir 'to wound')
to add to, to increase, to augment

entries.zh: 增减（买进时加增、卖出时减少；贸易中的增减）
entries.en: to increase and to diminish; to add in the buying and deduct in the selling (in trade)

entries.zh: 凑起来（聚拢凑集而增多）
entries.en: to put together, to gather, to accumulate; to increase more (cf. crecer 'to grow')
to commend, to give credit to; to praise (cf. alabar)
to commend and reward; to give credit, to acclaim
to refine, to purify by smelting; to assay (metals)
carnal act; sexual intercourse (cf. fornicar 'to fornicate')
